featured_reviews.name: abhinav awasthi
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is not a paid review, I am just a customer sharing feedback.
Ordered Surco Champion Speedo board on 24th June and received on 10th Morning (at Rajasthan). Less number of days than stated on their site. At this pandemic time great service despite less manpower.
Now coming to Product Delivery. Wonderful packing multilayered securing all corners with padded foam and play area separately padded with foam and cardboard. Received in great condition. Also received all the accessories (carrom men, Striker, Boric powder) as mentioned on product page.
Quality. Wonderful quality with English birch ply. Very smooth and even surface and exactly as per standards. heavy and robust board (ordered 20mm thickness).
Overall I enjoyed the product. Thanks for the great service. I will recommend everyone to buy from them, you will not be disappointed.

featured_reviews.name: mitra brihas
featured_reviews.review_text:
Just don't buy anything from Suri Sports or Surco boards; Period. They care least about their customers; I have purchased Surco Champion board. When I received the product it was damaged and had cracks at one of the edges; I had to call multiple times to even get a resolution which was to get a new board. After calling many times, they asked to send the board back with my own expense and they will send a new board. I took the board weighing more than 15-20kgs to VRL transport(they asked to transport only using VRL and I had to go 10 kms) and sent it. They sent the new board and to my surprise this was also damaged exactly at one of the corners/edges. I again informed them with the video/photo of the board. Despite calling them multiple times they are least bothered. They said that its damaged during transport and they can't do anything about it. It was possible for the board to have damaged during the transport but its the responsibility of the seller to make sure that its transported properly.

The arrogance, negligence and the irresponsibility of the seller is very very disappointing. Not once did they call themselves. I have raised the grievance with the consumer court now. This has been the worst buying experience. Even if you pay little extra go with better sellers

customer_updates.text: I visited this shop in Andheri to purchase some items. When I approached the counter to pay, I was informed that if I was paying online, they could not provide a physical bill; however, if I intended to pay in cash, I would have to proceed to a different counter to obtain one. When I went to the other counter, they simply told me, "We've already issued it to you online; you will receive it on your mobile phone—you just need to turn on your internet connection." This was baffling to me; normally, when you visit any shop—even a roadside stall—if you buy something as trivial as a napkin worth just 30 rupees, they still give you a bag. Yet here, despite purchasing an item worth 200 rupees, they refused to give me a bag. Consequently, I had to carry the item—a mobile tower—just as it was.
